name: Incel
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve messy brown hair, dark oversized hoodie, charcoal cargo trousers, battered sneakers and silver device with simple colored geometric stickers. Review isolated megaphones, laptop hinge continuity, readable title and final face visibility.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

Incel — Leave Me Alone.
IDENTITY: exact adult light-skinned man with messy shaggy brown hair, tired narrow eyes, short stubble, oversized dark charcoal-blue hoodie, gray undershirt, charcoal cargo trousers and scuffed gray/off-white lace-up sneakers. Preserve the small silver laptop tucked against his chest, with the same simple colored circle/triangle/diamond stickers. Maintain annoyed comic expression, not a glamorous makeover.
0–0.7s: establish his complete crouched figure, clutching the laptop. Three enormous floating silver megaphones crowd him from different angles; they emit only short abstract warm-white zigzag sound strokes, no speech, writing or faces. He shoots them an irritated sideways glance.
0.7–2.5s: he opens the laptop only a few inches and SLAMS its lid shut with both palms. From that one emphatic snap, a gigantic thick ivory shock ring with black ink edges expands outward. Camera rockets backward to show the small man at its center while all three oversized megaphones flip inside out like rubber funnels and rocket away to tiny specks at different depths. Hold the dominant lid-contact beat for a moment, then explosive acceleration. The expanding ring and speed strokes are finite shapes on cyan; never a solid full-screen flash, rectangular backdrop or new environment.
2.5–3.5s: camera punches back into his annoyed face, laptop hugged to his chest. Exact title LEAVE ME ALONE drops into place with a heavy angled slam below the face. He pulls one hoodie drawstring and gives a stubborn one-shoulder shrug.
3.5–5s: return to complete-character pose with his face still readable inside the hood. One miniature defeated megaphone drifts back toward his sneaker; he nudges it away with one lazy toe flick without looking. Stable final title and silhouette. SFX: overlapping abrasive horn squeaks without voices, laptop CLAP, gigantic expanding bass THOOM, three rubbery receding whistles, sudden clean quiet, title slam and a tiny final squeak. No music or intelligible voices.
